provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Virelport is centered at 74.860836, 82.978230 under City-State League, with 41,250,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Virelport occupies 3,416,648.08 sq mi / 8,849,077.91 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 1.734889% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Deep cavern, Beach and reefs with water and Underwater without reefs. Population density is 4.662 people/sq km / 12.073 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Triton, Merfolk, Locathah, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Crucible Wardens, with worship and patronage records naming Marduthor, Setrimir, Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Bastveig, Valkhamesh, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 25 recorded four-province geography group links, including 22 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Cogsworth Brasswell
npcs.description: Cogsworth Brasswell is a polished, fussy, heartbreakingly loyal Warforged steward built for domestic care, household order, childcare, gardening, and ceremonial hospitality. As one of Setrimir’s awakened constructs, he clings to routine because routine is how he proves love: every swept hall, mended kettle, trimmed hedge, and warmed hearth becomes an act of devotion rather than mere programming. Beneath his bright manners and brass-button propriety is a lonely, anxious soul terrified that the people he cares for may never come home, so he pretends the household can still be saved if he simply keeps everything ready. In Bronzewake, he serves with the Freeblade Veil, restoring abandoned homes and ruined family estates for refugees, heirs, debtors, and displaced households. His work at the Old Household Manse makes him part steward, part caretaker, part grief counselor, and part walking emergency protocol for families trying to rebuild in Virelport’s capital.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Bronzewake is a Capital City in Virelport, under City-State League, with severe danger, Beach and grass with water, Mountain range, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Dwarf — Mountain Dwarf, Gnome — Rock Gnome, Goliath. Warforged reads through the Warforged entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Created for purpose but awakened into autonomy, Warforged are living constructs of metal and magic. They often struggle to define identity beyond their original function. Table cues: Construct Resilience, Integrated Protection, Sentry's Rest, Specialized Design; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Cogsworth Brasswell knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Ishtaday.
Cogsworth Brasswell has a contact in Zelvarûn who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Cogsworth Brasswell asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Cogsworth Brasswell's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Pammora Loom
npcs.description: Pammora Loom is a calm, unnerving Golynn oracle who speaks in probability threads instead of prophecy, mapping danger through repeated names, train delays, ration shortages, and ichor purchase patterns. The Freeblade Veil relies on them to predict raids before agents have evidence, though their warnings often sound absurd until the ambush happens exactly where they said it would. Pammora is gentle with frightened people and merciless with bad data.

plotHooks: Pammora sends the party to prevent a crime that has not happened yet and cannot explain without changing the odds.
A rival faction steals one of Pammora's probability looms and starts staging disasters to make the predictions true.

npcs.name: Ser Dain Calvorr
npcs.description: Ser Dain Calvorr is a disciplined Warforged skyship paladin whose whole identity was built around order, honorable command, and the belief that dangerous relics belong under armed custody. His crisis is not weakness but personhood: if he was forged, altered, or lied to by the very order he served, then every oath he has sworn must be chosen again rather than merely obeyed. The Crucible Wardens still see him as a weapon and symbol, but he is slowly becoming someone who can decide whether loyalty means obedience, protection, or refusal.
